about_the_game:
“The wind rises… They say that the gaas resembles the raging ocean, but to me it is just like the sky… I guess that during the short winter one can see the gaas in its purest form,” thought Marena Chudskaya.

The visual novel Rattenwalzer is a story about the human willpower that regardless of sufferings and terrors lasting thousands of years has kept its beautiful nature. This visual novel comprehends such matters as the nature of the human and machine mind as a combination of the conscious and subconscious, coming of age and searching for personal happiness, the origin of interpersonal conflicts, hatred and violence, the willpower and strength to stay human even in the darkest of times.

Marena Chudskaya, who calls herself ‘an ever-burning star’, is the main character who accidentally falls into a trap designed for the ‘gods’ of the new world. Standing at the crossway of the past and the present, she gets pulled into a conflict with people… beings…  monsters…, who are ready to do whatever it takes to change the world.

Two chapters are available for gameplay:

  • Chapter I: The Zugzwang

  • Chapter II: Main Residential Complex Sun

Two more chapters are currently in production:

  • Chapter III: Main Residential Complex Bes’

  • Chapter IV: The Bull

Achtung! Attention! Read before playing:

This product may contain visual effects that can trigger epileptic seizures in some individuals. If you experience dizziness, confusion, visual disturbances, or seizures, stop using the product immediately and consult a doctor.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains scenes of cruelty, physical and psychological violence, unrealistic images of blood and mutilation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750Ti or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: sound card, up-to-date drivers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit) or Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i5 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
